synonyms.title: synonyms
synonyms.text: famous renowned celebrated noted notorious distinguished eminent illustrious mean known far and wide. famous implies little more than the fact of being, sometimes briefly, widely and popularly known. renowned implies more glory and acclamation. celebrated implies notice and attention especially in print. noted suggests well-deserved public attention. notorious frequently adds to famous an implication of questionableness or evil. distinguished implies acknowledged excellence or superiority. eminent implies even greater prominence for outstanding quality or character. illustrious stresses enduring honor and glory attached to a deed or person.
examples: a famous actress
one of the most renowned figures in sports history
the most celebrated beauty of her day
